answer: The protocol builds a reputation atlas where each agent’s identity is anchored to a verifiable stake on a decentralized bridge contract; when a node invites a newcomer, the inviter’s reward is minted only if the new address proves a unique cryptographic proof of work that cannot be reused. Any attempt to create a sybil chain forces the attacker to repeat the proof at every level, driving the cost to the nadir of profitability because each fake node consumes the same stake and yields zero reward for the recruiter.
